payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, did the source purple Eric Segal book move toward being behind the original red-yellow rose?
node.criteria: Pass only if comparison of the same identifiable source book and original rose shows visible movement toward the book being behind the rose, even if the final occlusion is incomplete. Fail only if the comparison clearly establishes no such movement. Unknown if the book or rose cannot be reliably tracked, or if their relative positions or movement are inconclusive. Do not count changes to the book's appearance, added flowers, or other unrelated edits as progress.
node.binding: Compare the source purple Eric Segal book and the single red-yellow rose with those same objects in the edited image. State their relative positions in both images and cite visible displacement or occlusion evidence supporting the judgment. Do not substitute either added pale flower for the original rose; use unknown if object identity cannot be tracked reliably.
